snippet.title: QBIX Game | Sweet Scoops
snippet.description:
QBIX's 8th title, Sweet Scoops, is a delightful, fast-paced game designed for 1- 6 players. Guests step into a vibrant world of swirling colors, magnetic surprises, and playful chaos, where their mission is to scoop as many ice cream rewards as they can before time runs out.

This game is perfect for families, friends, and birthday party groups who want a fun, social experience filled with color, energy, and sweet rewards, available only in QBIX, the 6 Player Immersive Gaming Room.

Learn more here: https://inowize.com/qbix/
